game_title: Call Stack Tower – Sleigh Stables Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables, the sleigh stables: the hold guard must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables: the sleigh stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Sleigh Stables, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round, winter bandits strike the chapel bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the chapel bell from winter bandits in Sleigh Stables: keep the stack_height meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: stack_height drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 34-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
